title: Joint minimum certificate-cover cost for subsets of the five cheapest cover targets (cost-16 parent extension, exact edge-cover determination)

candidate_roots_jsonl.note: deterministic artifact of the published enumerate_global_candidate_roots_20261118.py over the pinned worklist/census/ledger

method: Same cover semantics as the published joint analysis: a root covers the rows that generate it as a 1-stone D4-canonical extension (phase-1 enumeration). Joint target = union of the member parents' open non-STERILE rows. Every root covers at most 2 rows in every subset universe (asserted), so the minimum cover size equals r - m with m the maximum matching of the pair graph; m is computed exactly with a self-contained blossom algorithm validated against brute force on 3000 deterministic random graphs, and the exhibited witness (one root per matched pair plus one covering root per unmatched row) is machine-verified. exact means witness size equals ceil(r/maxspan). All 15 published 4-parent subset sizes are reproduced as a cross-check.
interpretation_guard: Bookkeeping and combinatorics only. Joint cover cost presumes every chosen root would validate as a certificate; sharing benefit is a planning count, not a WIN/REFUTED claim. REFUTED-D10 and STERILE are not LOSS proofs.
